name: What is involved in the drywall finishing process?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in the drywall finishing process?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drywall finishing is the process of preparing newly installed drywall for paint or other wall coverings. It typically involves applying multiple coats of joint compound to seams and fastener heads, sanding each layer smooth, and ensuring a uniform surface. The process requires careful attention to detail to achieve a seamless finish, especially for areas that will be highly visible. This preparation is crucial as it directly impacts the final look and durability of your walls.
acceptedAnswer.description: Drywall finishing involves applying and sanding multiple coats of joint compound to create a smooth, paint-ready surface.
